title: Exact Record Omission in Delta Attention: A Transport Criterion, Its Cost, and a Replay Certificate
abstract: arXiv:2609.06872v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When a user asks an assistant to forget a record, the test is whether the memory now matches the state it would hold if the record had never been stored. Independently encoded rows can be removed directly; a recurrent memory folds records into an evolving state. One hope is a receipt: save the difference the record made when it arrived, carry it forward through later updates, and subtract it, so that deletion costs one fixed-size edit no matter how long the conversation runs. We show that a transported receipt reaches exact omission if and only if the changes the record induces in later updates cancel out on net, and we measure whether they do on the released 48B Kimi Linear hybrid. They do not: after 4,096 further tokens the record still leaves an imprint of about 4.5% of the state norm that none of the tested receipt classes removes, recomputing half the suffix closes less than half the gap, and the per-token log a receipt needs costs

translated_title: Delta注意力机制中的精确记录删除：传输判据、其代价与重放证书
translated_abstract: 当用户要求助手忘记某条记录时，检验标准是：记忆当前的状态是否与该记录从未被存储时本应处于的状态一致。独立编码的行可以直接删除；而循环记忆则会将记录折叠进一个不断演化的状态中。一种期望的方案是“收据”（receipt）：保存该记录到来时所产生的差异，在后续更新中将其向前传递，然后将其减去，从而无论对话进行多长，删除都只需一次固定大小的编辑。我们证明，被传递的收据能够实现精确删除，当且仅当该记录在后续更新中所诱导的变化在净额上相互抵消；并且我们在公开发布的48B Kimi Linear混合模型上实测了这种抵消是否发生。结果表明并未发生：在再经过4,096个token之后，该记录仍留下约占状态范数4.5%的印记，所测试的任何一类收据都无法将其移除；重算后半段后缀也只能弥补不到一半的差距；而收据所需的逐token日志的代价是……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文证明了在Delta注意力类循环记忆中，通过“收据”传递实现记录精确删除当且仅当该记录诱导的后续更新变化净额为零，并在48B Kimi Linear混合模型上实证表明该条件不成立——记录会留下现有收据类方法均无法消除、重算也只能部分弥补的持久印记。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that a transported receipt achieves exact record omission in delta attention if and only if the record-induced changes in later updates cancel out on net, and empirically shows on a 48B Kimi Linear hybrid that they do not, leaving an imprint of about 4.5% of the state norm that no tested receipt class removes and that recomputing half the suffix fails to fully close.
